name: io.github.chenshiyilisha/multidb-mcp
title: MultiDB MCP
description: MCP server for Dameng (DM8), SQL Server, and MySQL — read-only by default, granular write perms

environmentVariables.name: MULTIDB_DB_TYPE
environmentVariables.description: Database type: dameng, sqlserver, or mysql

environmentVariables.name: MULTIDB_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Database port (e.g. 5236 for Dameng, 1433 for SQL Server, 3306 for MySQL)

environmentVariables.name: MULTIDB_SCHEMA
environmentVariables.description: Schema name for Dameng, or database name for SQL Server / MySQL

environmentVariables.name: MULTIDB_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Read-only master switch. true = only SELECT/SHOW/DESCRIBE/EXPLAIN/WITH (default true)

environmentVariables.name: MULTIDB_CONNECTIONS
environmentVariables.description: Optional JSON array for multiple connections (overrides single-connection vars, contains credentials)
